Private Function Shown(ByVal items As Variant) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = LBound(items) To UBound(items)
        s = s & "|" & TypeName(items(i)) & ":" & items(i)
    Next
    Shown = LBound(items) & "-" & UBound(items) & " " & Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Column(ByVal ws As Worksheet, ByVal address As String) As String
    Dim c As Range, s As String
    For Each c In ws.Range(address)
        s = s & "|" & c.Formula
    Next
    Column = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, n As Long, s As String, v As String, i As Long
    n = Application.CustomListCount
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@count=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(1))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@list 1=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(2))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@list 2=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(3))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@list 3=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(4))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@list 4=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.GetCustomListNum(Array("Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat")))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@num days=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.GetCustomListNum(Array("sun", "mon", "tue", "wed", "thu", "fri", "sat")))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@num lower=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.GetCustomListNum(Array("Sun", "Mon")))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@num part=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.GetCustomListNum(Array("x", "y")))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@num none=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    Application.AddCustomList Array("Low", "Medium", "High")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@add=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.GetCustomListNum(Array("Low", "Medium", "High")) - n)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@num added=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(n + 1))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@added=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    Application.AddCustomList Array("Low", "Medium", "High")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@add again=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    Application.AddCustomList Array("low", "medium", "high")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@add lower=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    Application.AddCustomList Array(" Alpha ", "Beta,Gamma", 3, "", "Delta")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n) & " " & Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@add odd=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("A1:A3").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("x1", "y1", "z1"))
    Application.AddCustomList ws.Range("A1:A3")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@add range=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("B1:D2").Value = Array("b1", "c1", "d1")
    ws.Range("B2:D2").Value = Array("b2", "c2", "d2")
    Application.AddCustomList ws.Range("B1:D2")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@add block=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    Application.AddCustomList ws.Range("B1:D2"), True
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@add block rows=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    Application.AddCustomList Array("Only")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@add one=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("E1:E2").Value = Application.Transpose(Array(1, 2))
    Application.AddCustomList ws.Range("E1:E2")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n) & " " & Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@add number=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    Application.DeleteCustomList 1
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@delete built in=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    Application.DeleteCustomList Application.CustomListCount + 1
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = "done"
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@delete past=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(0))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@contents 0=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount + 1))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@contents past=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("F1").Value = "Medium"
    ws.Range("F1").AutoFill ws.Range("F1:F5")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Column(ws, "F1:F5")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@fill=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("G1").Value = "medium"
    ws.Range("G1").AutoFill ws.Range("G1:G4")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Column(ws, "G1:G4")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@fill lower=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("H1").Value = "Low"
    ws.Range("H2").Value = "High"
    ws.Range("H1:H2").AutoFill ws.Range("H1:H6")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Column(ws, "H1:H6")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@fill two=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("I1:I7").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("High", "low", "Zeta", "Medium", 5, "high", "Apple"))
    ws.Range("I1:I7").Sort Key1:=ws.Range("I1"), Order1:=xlAscending, Header:=xlNo, OrderCustom:=n + 2
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Column(ws, "I1:I7")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@sort=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("J1:J7").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("High", "low", "Zeta", "Medium", 5, "high", "Apple"))
    ws.Range("J1:J7").Sort Key1:=ws.Range("J1"), Order1:=xlDescending, Header:=xlNo, OrderCustom:=n + 2
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Column(ws, "J1:J7")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@sort down=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("K1:K5").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("Wed", "Sunday", "Mon", "sat", "Tue"))
    ws.Range("K1:K5").Sort Key1:=ws.Range("K1"), Order1:=xlAscending, Header:=xlNo, OrderCustom:=2
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Column(ws, "K1:K5")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@sort days=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("L1:L2").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("b", "a"))
    ws.Range("L1:L2").Sort Key1:=ws.Range("L1"), Header:=xlNo, OrderCustom:=Application.CustomListCount + 2
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Column(ws, "L1:L2")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@sort past=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@count now=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    Application.AddCustomList Array("p1", 3, "p2")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n) & " " & Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@odd items=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    Application.AddCustomList Array("q1", "", "q2")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n) & " " & Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@empty item=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    Application.AddCustomList Array(1, 2)
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@numbers only=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("M1:N3").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array("m1", "m2", "m3")))
    ws.Range("M1").Value = "m1"
    ws.Range("M2").Value = "m2"
    ws.Range("M3").Value = "m3"
    ws.Range("N1").Value = "n1"
    ws.Range("N2").Value = "n2"
    ws.Range("N3").Value = "n3"
    Application.AddCustomList ws.Range("M1:N3")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n) & " " & Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount - 1)) & " / " & Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@block cols=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("O1").Value = "o1"
    ws.Range("O2").Value = "o2"
    ws.Range("P1").Value = "p1x"
    ws.Range("P2").Value = "p2x"
    Application.AddCustomList ws.Range("O1:P2"), False
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n) & " " & Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount - 1)) & " / " & Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@block cols false=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("Q1").Value = "q1x"
    ws.Range("Q2").Value = "q2x"
    ws.Range("R1").Value = "r1x"
    ws.Range("R2").Value = "r2x"
    Application.AddCustomList ws.Range("Q1:R2"), True
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n) & " " & Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount - 1)) & " / " & Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@block rows true=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    Application.AddCustomList ws.Range("A1:A3")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@range again=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("S1").Value = "s1"
    ws.Range("S3").Value = "s3"
    Application.AddCustomList ws.Range("S1:S3")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n) & " " & Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(Application.CustomListCount))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@range blank=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.GetCustomListNum(ws.Range("A1:A3")) - n)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@num range=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.GetCustomListNum(Array("LOW", "medium", "HIGH")) - n)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@num other case=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("T1").Value = "MEDIUM"
    ws.Range("T1").AutoFill ws.Range("T1:T3")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Column(ws, "T1:T3")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@fill upper=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("U1").Value = "mEDium"
    ws.Range("U1").AutoFill ws.Range("U1:U3")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Column(ws, "U1:U3")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@fill mixed=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("V5").Value = "Low"
    ws.Range("V5").AutoFill ws.Range("V2:V5")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Column(ws, "V2:V5")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@fill up=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("W1").Value = "Low"
    ws.Range("W1").AutoFill ws.Range("W1:W3"), xlFillCopy
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Column(ws, "W1:W3")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@fill copy=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("X1").Value = "Low"
    ws.Range("X2").Value = "Medium"
    ws.Range("X3").Value = "Low"
    ws.Range("X1:X3").AutoFill ws.Range("X1:X6")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Column(ws, "X1:X6")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@fill skip=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    ws.Range("Y1").Value = " Alpha "
    ws.Range("Y1").AutoFill ws.Range("Y1:Y4")
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = Column(ws, "Y1:Y4")
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@fill spaced=" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    Application.DeleteCustomList n + 1
    If Err.Number = 0 Then v = CStr(Application.CustomListCount - n) & " " & Shown(Application.GetCustomListContents(n + 1))
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then v = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    s = s & "@@@delete added=" & v
    For i = Application.CustomListCount To n + 1 Step -1
        Application.DeleteCustomList i
    Next
    s = s & "@@@restored=" & (Application.CustomListCount = n)
    wb.Close False
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
